```{r data read & functions, include=FALSE}
participantList <- read.csv("Exp2_Data/Exp2_participantList.csv")

cfmtData <- participantList %>% 
  select(ID,CFMT)
cbPalette <- viridis(n=2)


#1. MEAN ABSOLUTE PERCENTAGE ERROR (MAPE)
MAPE = function(y_actual,y_predict){
  mean(abs((y_actual-y_predict)/y_actual))*100
}
 
#2. R SQUARED error metric -- Coefficient of Determination
RSQUARE = function(y_actual,y_predict){
  cor(y_actual,y_predict)^2
}

RMSE = function(y_actual,y_predict){
  mean((y_actual-y_predict)^2)^0.5
}

```

```{r data processing aprime}
aPrimeData <- read.csv("Exp2_Data/Exp2_aprime.csv")
aPrimeData$Group<- factor(aPrimeData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))

summaryAPrimeData <- aPrimeData %>%
  gather(key="VisualCondition",value="aprime",X12:X100) %>%
  mutate(VisualCondition = as.integer(gsub('[a-zA-Z]', '',VisualCondition)))

summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition <- factor(summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition, levels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

summaryAPrimeData$WindowSize <- factor(summaryAPrimeData$VisualCondition, levels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"),labels=c("30","25","20","15","10","5"))
```

```{r aprime modelling fit}
Condition<-0
LR_T <- 0
RMSE_L <- 0
RMSE_T <- 0

aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY <- summaryAPrimeData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Typical Viewers")
aPrimeData_SRonly2WAY <- summaryAPrimeData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Super-recognizers")

model_aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY<- lm(data = aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY, aprime~CFMT+VisualCondition)
summary(model_aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY)

linear_predictions<- predict(model_aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY,newdata=aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY)
RMSE_L = RMSE(aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY$aprime,linear_predictions) # Using R-SQUARE error metrics to check for the error rate and accuracy level
linear_predictions<- predict(model_aPrimeData_TVonly2WAY,newdata=aPrimeData_SRonly2WAY)
RMSE_T = RMSE(aPrimeData_SRonly2WAY$aprime,linear_predictions) # Using R-SQUARE error metrics to check for the error rate and accuracy level
LR_T = RSQUARE(aPrimeData_SRonly2WAY$aprime,linear_predictions) # Using R-SQUARE error metrics to check for the error rate and accuracy level
Condition<-"2-WAY"
full_LR <- data.frame(Condition,RMSE_L,RMSE_T,LR_T)
```

```{r data processing trialData}
trialDataw_CFMT <- read.csv("Exp2_Data/Exp2_Latency_Gini.csv")

trialDataJoiner <- trialDataw_CFMT %>% 
  rename(Trial = trial_number) %>% 
  select(ID,Trial,image,CFMT, Order, timeanswer)

trialDataw_CFMT$group<- factor(trialDataw_CFMT$group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))
trialDataw_CFMT$phase<- factor(trialDataw_CFMT$phase, levels = c(1,2),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))
trialDataw_CFMT$visualcondition<- factor(trialDataw_CFMT$visualcondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

RecognitionPhaseOnlyData <- trialDataw_CFMT %>% 
  filter(phase=="Face Recognition")

RTPlotData <- RecognitionPhaseOnlyData %>% 
  group_by(subject_number,visualcondition,group,CFMT) %>% 
  summarise(meanRT = mean(timeanswer),CFMT=mean(CFMT))

GiniPlotData <- trialDataw_CFMT %>% 
  group_by(subject_number,visualcondition,phase,group,CFMT) %>% 
  summarise(meanGini = mean(Gini), CFMT=mean(CFMT))

GiniPlotDataSimplified <- GiniPlotData %>% 
  group_by(subject_number,phase,group,CFMT) %>% 
  summarise(meanGini = mean(meanGini), CFMT=mean(CFMT))
  
```

```{r rt modelling fit}
Condition<-0
LR_T <- 0
RMSE_L <- 0
RMSE_T <- 0

RTPlotData_TVonly <- RTPlotData %>% 
  filter(group=="Typical Viewers")
RTPlotData_SRonly <- RTPlotData %>% 
  filter(group=="Super-recognizers")

model_RTPlotData_TVonly<- lm(data = RTPlotData_TVonly, meanRT~CFMT+visualcondition)
summary(model_RTPlotData_TVonly)

linear_predictions<- predict(model_RTPlotData_TVonly,newdata=RTPlotData_SRonly)
RMSE_L = RMSE(RTPlotData_TVonly$meanRT,linear_predictions)
linear_predictions<- predict(model_RTPlotData_TVonly,newdata=RTPlotData_SRonly)
RMSE_T = RMSE(RTPlotData_SRonly$meanRT,linear_predictions) 
LR_T = RSQUARE(RTPlotData_SRonly$meanRT,linear_predictions) 
Condition<-"3-WAY"
full_LR <- data.frame(Condition,RMSE_L,RMSE_T,LR_T)
```

```{r data processing Fixation Statistics}
fixationData <- read.csv("Exp2_Data/Exp2_fixationCount_Duration.csv")

fixationData<- inner_join(fixationData,trialDataJoiner,by=c("ID","Trial"))

fixationData$Group<- factor(fixationData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))
fixationData$Phase<- factor(fixationData$Phase, levels = c(1,2),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))
fixationData$windowsize<- factor(fixationData$VisualCondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("30","25","20","15","10","5"))
fixationData$VisualCondition<- factor(fixationData$VisualCondition, levels = c("1","6","5","4","3","2"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))

trialFixationData <- fixationData %>%
  group_by(ID,Trial,image,Group,Phase,VisualCondition,windowsize) %>% 
  summarise(fixationCount = n(),meanFixationDuration = mean(FixationDuration)*1000,meanGazeDistance=mean(DistanceFromCenter), meanDistanceBetweenFix = mean(DistanceFromLastFix,na.rm=TRUE), sumDistanceBetweenFix = sum(DistanceFromLastFix,na.rm=TRUE), CFMT = mean(CFMT), Order = mean(Order), timeanswer = mean(timeanswer))

write.csv(trialFixationData,"Exp2_Data/Exp2_trialFixationData.csv",row.names = FALSE)

fixationPlotData<-trialFixationData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Group,Phase,VisualCondition,windowsize) %>% 
  summarise(meanFixationCount = mean(fixationCount),meanFixationDuration = mean(meanFixationDuration),meanGazeDistance=mean(meanGazeDistance),meanDistanceBetweenFix = mean(meanDistanceBetweenFix,na.rm=TRUE),mean_sumDistanceBetweenFix = mean(sumDistanceBetweenFix),CFMT = mean(CFMT),Order = mean(Order))

fixationPlotData_long<- fixationPlotData %>% 
  gather(key="DV",value="Value",meanFixationCount:meanDistanceBetweenFix)

fixationPlotData_long$DV<-factor(fixationPlotData_long$DV,levels=c("meanFixationCount","meanFixationDuration","meanGazeDistance","meanDistanceBetweenFix"),labels=c("Count","Duration (ms)", "Center Distance (degrees)","Travelled (degrees)"))

fixationPlotDataSimplified<-fixationPlotData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Group,Phase) %>% 
  summarise(meanFixationCount = mean(meanFixationCount),meanFixationDuration = mean(meanFixationDuration),meanGazeDistance=mean(meanGazeDistance),meanDistanceBetweenFix = mean(meanDistanceBetweenFix,na.rm=TRUE),mean_sumDistanceBetweenFix = mean(mean_sumDistanceBetweenFix),CFMT = mean(CFMT),Order = mean(Order))
```

```{r fixation count modelling fit}
Condition<-0
LR_T <- 0
RMSE_L <- 0
RMSE_T <- 0

fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY <- fixationPlotData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Typical Viewers")
fixationPlotData_SRonly3WAY <- fixationPlotData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Super-recognizers")

model_fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY<- lm(data = fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY, meanFixationCount~CFMT+Phase*VisualCondition)
summary(model_fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY)

linear_predictions<- predict(model_fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY,newdata=fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY)
RMSE_L = RMSE(fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY$meanFixationCount,linear_predictions)
linear_predictions<- predict(model_fixationPlotData_TVonly3WAY,newdata=fixationPlotData_SRonly3WAY)
RMSE_T = RMSE(fixationPlotData_SRonly3WAY$meanFixationCount,linear_predictions) 
LR_T = RSQUARE(fixationPlotData_SRonly3WAY$meanFixationCount,linear_predictions) 
Condition<-"3-WAY"
full_LR <- data.frame(Condition,RMSE_L,RMSE_T,LR_T)
```

```{r data processing PC1}
pcaData <- read.csv("Exp2_Data/Exp2_pc1_loading.csv")
pcaData$Aperture <- factor(pcaData$Aperture,levels = c("30","25","20","15","10","5"), labels = c("100","60","48","36","24","12"))
pcaData$Group<- factor(pcaData$Group, levels = c(1,2), labels = c("Typical Viewers","Super-recognizers"))

pcaPlotData <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1), CFMT = mean(CFMTp),Order=mean(Order))

pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase:Aperture,values_from=meanPC1)

pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd <- pcaData %>%
  group_by(ID,Phase,Aperture,Group) %>%
  summarise(sdPC1 = sd(PC1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Phase:Aperture,values_from=sdPC1)

pcaData$Phase<- factor(pcaData$Phase, levels = c("Learning","Recognition"),labels = c("Face Learning","Face Recognition"))
pcaData$Order <- as.numeric(pcaData$Order)

pcaPlotData_simplified <- pcaData %>% 
  group_by(ID,Phase,Group) %>% 
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1), CFMT = mean(CFMTp),Order=mean(Order))

cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_100,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_100)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_60,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_60)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_48,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_48)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_36,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_36)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_24,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_24)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Learning_12,pcaPlotData_byPhase_mean$Recognition_12)

meanPCAData <- pcaData %>%
  group_by(Phase,Group) %>%
  summarise(meanPC1 = mean(PC1))

cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_100,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_100)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_60,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_60)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_48,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_48)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_36,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_36)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_24,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_24)
cor.test(pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Learning_12,pcaPlotData_byPhase_sd$Recognition_12)
```


```{r pc1 modelling fit}
Condition<-0
LR_T <- 0
RMSE_L <- 0
RMSE_T <- 0

pcaPlotData_TVonly <- pcaPlotData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Typical Viewers")
pcaPlotData_SRonly <- pcaPlotData %>% 
  filter(Group=="Super-recognizers")


## 3 way linear model
model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN<- lm(data = pcaPlotData_TVonly, meanPC1~CFMT+Phase*Aperture)
summary(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN)

linear_predictions<- predict(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN,newdata=pcaPlotData_TVonly)
RMSE_L = RMSE(pcaPlotData_TVonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions)
linear_predictions<- predict(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN,newdata=pcaPlotData_SRonly)
RMSE_T = RMSE(pcaPlotData_SRonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions) 
LR_T = RSQUARE(pcaPlotData_SRonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions) 
Condition<-"LINEAR"
full_LR <- data.frame(Condition,RMSE_L,RMSE_T,LR_T)

## 3 way quad model
model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD<- lm(data = pcaPlotData_TVonly, meanPC1~poly(CFMT,2)+Phase*Aperture)
summary(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD)

linear_predictions<- predict(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD,newdata=pcaPlotData_TVonly)
RMSE_L = RMSE(pcaPlotData_TVonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions)
linear_predictions<- predict(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD,newdata=pcaPlotData_SRonly)
RMSE_T = RMSE(pcaPlotData_SRonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions) 
LR_T = RSQUARE(pcaPlotData_SRonly$meanPC1,linear_predictions) 
Condition<-"QUAD"
full_LR <- data.frame(Condition,RMSE_L,RMSE_T,LR_T)


model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN_GLS<- gls(data = pcaPlotData_TVonly, meanPC1~CFMT+Phase*Aperture, method = "ML")
model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD_GLS<- gls(data = pcaPlotData_TVonly, meanPC1~poly(CFMT,2)+Phase*Aperture, method = "ML")

anova(model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyLIN_GLS,model_pcaPlotData_TVonlyQUAD_GLS)
```
